newsitem.title: USA: American Disposal Q4 net up after purchases.
newsitem.headline: American Disposal Q4 net up after purchases.

text.p: American Disposal Services Inc said Thursday an acquisitons program and growth in its landfill operations helped the company post a profit in the fourth quarter ended December 31 compared to a loss.
Net income totaled $557,000, or $0.06 a share, versus a loss of $2.8 million, or $0.55 a share, in the same period a year ago, the company said.
Revenues reached $16.5 million, up from $10.1 million in the fourth quarter of 1995, when it owned 17 fewer companies and had yet to sign several new operating contracts.
American Disposal provides solid waste processing services in nine states. Its shares closed down one Thursday at 16-1/2.
